parts.title: Deltagelse i danske mesterskaber for løftere der repræsenterer en anden nation

ops.reason: Three decisions set the residence period required of foreigners (24 months, confirmed, then 6 months), while one decision bars lifters representing another nation from DM/JM/SM and records, a separate rule.

ops.title: Deltagelse i stærkmands- og bodybuildingkonkurrencer
ops.reason: The rejected 2014 proposal of a 1-year quarantine for competing in bodybuilding/strongman federations would have changed the existing rule on DSF lifters' participation in strongman competitions and its quarantine.
The 2009 rule on stating name and licence number when paying the annual licence is about how the licence is paid, which was later replaced by the licence being invoiced.
